name: Lucie Li
reason: Human review (2026-10-17): the project owner read her public LinkedIn profile in a browser and shared screenshots; scripts do not read LinkedIn. Identity: the profile (Xin Li, George Mason University) lists the same PhD (Information Systems, Washington State University) and the same three earlier employers (UNC Pembroke, USF St. Petersburg, Loyola University Maryland) as her GMU profile. Its experience section gives Associate Professor, UNC Pembroke, Aug 2004 - Dec 2010; Instructor, USF St. Petersburg, Aug 2011 - Aug 2016; Affiliate Assistant Professor, Loyola University Maryland, Aug 2016 - Jun 2017; George Mason University from Aug 2017; education Ph.D. Information Systems 2000-2004 and MBA 2000-2002, both Washington State. The doctorate is dated by the Washington State University Research Exchange record of Xin Li's PhD dissertation (08/2004, advisor Joseph S. Valacich). UNC Pembroke, begun in August 2004, is therefore the first post-PhD job.
